repos.description: LANGA — open tools, live from GitHub. Humans decide.
repos.name: langacorp.github.io

repos.description: Find secrets in a git repository by shape, across every ref and every deleted file. Position and category, never the value. Runs before every publication from AEGIS.
repos.name: leakform

repos.description: Find numbers written by hand that no longer match their source. Three outcomes: matched, drifted, or the source did not answer — and the third is the point.
repos.name: countdrift

repos.description: Attest that an ML-KEM-768 key exchange really happened, and record it with an expiry. It does not encrypt anything, and the README says so first. Built for AEGIS.
repos.name: kemproof

repos.description: Small Flutter pieces pulled out of a production app and de-coupled: interaction widgets, and a failure model that keeps six outcomes distinct instead of collapsing them into one error. Flutter and nothing else.
repos.name: langa-flutter-bits

repos.description: Seven reusable pieces from a React Three Fiber project: hooks for interactive 3D objects, two GPU shaders, a base material. No scene, no models, no dependencies beyond three and r3f.
repos.name: langa-3d

repos.description: WordPress plugin for branding, UI/UX and central site management: maintenance mode, preloader, favicon, admin bar, plus an HMAC-signed client that connects a site to a LANGA management server. GPLv2+.
repos.name: langa-tools-lite

repos.description: Two guards for apps that open their own pages in a WebView: is this URL really ours, and has the page just shown a sign-in wall. No dependencies, nothing hardcoded.
repos.name: login-wall

repos.description: Measure whether the copies that should be identical still are. Divergence is a fact; choosing the right version is a decision AEGIS leaves to a person.
repos.name: samecheck

repos.description: Compare what a system claims with what can be measured, from independent sources. The check AEGIS runs before a number is allowed into a report.
repos.name: provenreal

repos.description: Check that a route really exists — by content, not by status code. Catches soft-404s: pages that answer 200 and serve something else. An AEGIS guard.
repos.name: realroute

repos.description: LANGA — organisation profile. AEGIS, Talos, and the tools that came out of running many hands against a real estate of services.
repos.name: .github

repos.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization server in Node.js, TypeScript and MongoDB. Written in 2021, never deployed, published as-is under MIT so it can be read and reused.
repos.name: auth-server
